title: Read-then-write race: two gateways both allow the 5th request (limit 4)
caption: Fix: one atomic operation (INCR, or a short server-side script) that increments and returns the new value.

messages.label: GET count → 3
messages.note: Gateway 2 reads before gateway 1 writes back. It also sees 3.

messages.label: SET count = 4 (allow)
messages.note: Both allowed: 5 requests passed a limit of 4, and the counter says 4. The lost update grows with traffic.

messages.label: fix: INCR → 5 > 4 → reject
messages.note: With an atomic INCR each gateway gets a distinct new value (4, then 5), so exactly one is rejected.
